label: Diagram 6.1
caption: Diagram 6.1 Type D, plan view showing minimum dimensions | ONLINE V
description: This is a plan view, labelled at the foot "Diagram 6.1 Type D, plan view showing minimum dimensions". On the left, a "Shelf" sits at the top corner, with the "Space for disposal bin" to its right. A horizontal dimension of 540mm spans the combined width of the shelf and the bin space, and a vertical dimension of 210mm indicates the depth of the bin space. A vertical dimension of 910mm minimum runs down the left edge, with a 200mm dimension at the bottom left. A horizontal dimension of 1740mm minimum spans the top. The "High hook and low hook" are shown on the top wall, and "Activity space" is labelled at the top right. A green shaded rectangle, keyed in a legend as "Activity space WC", occupies the centre, enclosing a dashed circle dimensioned 465mm Ø. A "Column of clearance" is indicated by a vertical line in the lower part of this rectangle. On the right, a 650mm vertical dimension is given, alongside dashed lines showing a door swing. Four notes appear at the right, referencing Appendix D, a concealed cistern, centring the WC mid-line on the rear wall, and centring the column of clearance on the WC.
